title: watch add --json
description: changed is false when the owner and labels were already present. baselined is false for a query watch, for --no-baseline and when a digest already existed. pr is the PR row (state, status, terminal_at and terminal_kind of an existing terminal row, for which no event is emitted), null for a query watch. cursor is the events head read at the start of the same transaction as the write: for a consumer with no stored cursor; one that holds a cursor ignores it.
